scripts.dev: set NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation && concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/aureaa-main" "npm run dev --prefix admin_module/backend" "npm run dev --prefix admin_module/frontend"
scripts.dev:customer: set NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation && concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/aureaa-main"
scripts.dev:admin: set NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation && concurrently "npm run dev --prefix admin_module/backend" "npm run dev --prefix admin_module/frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend/aureaa-main" "npm start --prefix admin_module/backend" "npm start --prefix admin_module/frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend/aureaa-main && npm install --prefix admin_module/backend && npm install --prefix admin_module/frontend && npm install
